newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi Arabia - Sept 12.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi Arabia - Sept 12.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Saudi Arabian press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Defence Minister Prince Sultan says the United States did not ask to use Saudi Arabia as a base to launch attacks on Iraq. If it had, Saudi Arabia would have refused the request.
- Education ministry in 222 new projects costing 1.7 billion riyals.
- Commerce minister meets Australian deputy foreign minister.
- Saudi Arabia to build new 57.8-megawatt power station in Tabuk at a cost of 180 million riyals. The contract, with the National Contracting Co, will be signed on Tuesday.
- The higher commission for collecting donations for Bosnia has donated 2.5 million riyals to Bosnian orphans.
- Around 23,737 Saudis, including women, employed at various government departments last year.
